<!DOCTYPE html>

<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Essence Maker Decor – Spaces That Reflect You</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,600;1,300;1,400&family=Montserrat:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
  :root {
    --orange: #E07B39;
    --dark-orange: #C45E1A;
    --navy: #1a2340;
    --cream: #FAF7F2;
    --warm-white: #FFFCF8;
    --text-dark: #1a1a1a;
    --text-mid: #4a4a4a;
  }
  html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
  body { font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; background: var(--warm-white); color: var(--text-dark); overflow-x: hidden; }

nav {
position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 100;
display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
padding: 18px 48px;
background: rgba(255,252,248,0.92); backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(224,123,57,0.15);
}
nav img.nav-logo { height: 52px; object-fit: contain; }
nav a {
text-decoration: none; color: var(–orange);
font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase;
border: 1.5px solid var(–orange); padding: 10px 22px; border-radius: 2px; transition: all 0.25s;
}
nav a:hover { background: var(–orange); color: #fff; }

.hero {
min-height: 100vh; display: grid; place-items: center;
text-align: center; padding: 120px 24px 80px; position: relative;
background: radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 60% at 50% 0%, rgba(224,123,57,0.08) 0%, transparent 70%), var(–warm-white);
}
.hero::before {
content: ‘’; position: absolute; inset: 0;
background-image:
repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, transparent, transparent 39px, rgba(224,123,57,0.04) 40px),
repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, transparent 39px, rgba(224,123,57,0.04) 40px);
pointer-events: none;
}
.hero-inner { position: relative; max-width: 780px; }
.hero-logo { width: min(320px, 75vw); margin: 0 auto 40px; display: block; animation: fadeUp 0.9s ease both; }
.hero h1 {
font-family: ‘Cormorant Garamond’, serif;
font-size: clamp(2.8rem, 7vw, 5.2rem); font-weight: 300; font-style: italic;
line-height: 1.1; color: var(–navy); animation: fadeUp 0.9s 0.15s ease both;
}
.hero h1 span { color: var(–orange); font-style: normal; font-weight: 600; }
.hero p {
margin: 24px auto 44px; max-width: 520px;
font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 300; color: var(–text-mid);
line-height: 1.8; letter-spacing: 0.03em; animation: fadeUp 0.9s 0.28s ease both;
}
.hero-cta { display: inline-flex; gap: 16px; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; animation: fadeUp 0.9s 0.4s ease both; }
.btn-primary {
background: var(–orange); color: #fff; padding: 16px 36px;
font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase;
text-decoration: none; border-radius: 2px; transition: all 0.25s;
box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(224,123,57,0.25);
}
.btn-primary:hover { background: var(–dark-orange); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(224,123,57,0.35); }
.btn-ghost {
color: var(–navy); padding: 16px 36px;
font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase;
text-decoration: none; border: 1.5px solid var(–navy); border-radius: 2px; transition: all 0.25s;
}
.btn-ghost:hover { background: var(–navy); color: #fff; }

.divider { height: 3px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(–orange), transparent); margin: 0 10%; }

.services { padding: 100px 48px; max-width: 1100px; margin: 0 auto; }
.section-label { font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(–orange); margin-bottom: 12px; }
.section-title { font-family: ‘Cormorant Garamond’, serif; font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3.2rem); font-weight: 300; font-style: italic; color: var(–navy); margin-bottom: 56px; }
.services-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr)); gap: 2px; }
.service-card { background: var(–cream); padding: 44px 36px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; transition: transform 0.3s; }
.service-card::before { content: ‘’; position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 3px; background: var(–orange); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 0.35s; }
.service-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); }
.service-card:hover::before { transform: scaleX(1); }
.service-icon { font-size: 2rem; margin-bottom: 20px; }
.service-card h3 { font-family: ‘Cormorant Garamond’, serif; font-size: 1.4rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(–navy); margin-bottom: 12px; }
.service-card p { font-size: 0.82rem; line-height: 1.75; color: var(–text-mid); }

.why { background: var(–navy); color: #fff; padding: 100px 48px; text-align: center; position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
.why::before { content: ‘’; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: radial-gradient(ellipse 70% 70% at 50% 100%, rgba(224,123,57,0.18) 0%, transparent 70%); pointer-events: none; }
.why .section-label { color: var(–orange); }
.why .section-title { color: #fff; margin-bottom: 60px; }
.why-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr)); gap: 40px; max-width: 900px; margin: 0 auto; position: relative; }
.why-num { font-family: ‘Cormorant Garamond’, serif; font-size: 3.5rem; font-weight: 300; color: var(–orange); line-height: 1; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.why-item h4 { font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 10px; color: #fff; }
.why-item p { font-size: 0.8rem; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); line-height: 1.7; }

.contact { padding: 100px 48px; max-width: 760px; margin: 0 auto; text-align: center; }
.contact-cards { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 20px; justify-content: center; margin-top: 48px; }
.contact-card {
background: var(–cream); padding: 32px 40px; border-left: 3px solid var(–orange);
text-align: left; flex: 1 1 260px; text-decoration: none; color: inherit;
transition: transform 0.25s, box-shadow 0.25s; display: block;
}
.contact-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); }
.contact-card .label { font-size: 0.65rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(–orange); margin-bottom: 8px; }
.contact-card .value { font-family: ‘Cormorant Garamond’, serif; font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(–navy); }

footer { background: var(–navy); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); text-align: center; padding: 32px 24px; font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; }
footer span { color: var(–orange); }

@keyframes fadeUp { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(28px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }

@media (max-width: 640px) {
nav { padding: 14px 20px; }
.services, .contact { padding: 72px 24px; }
.why { padding: 72px 24px; }
}
</style>

</head>
<body>

<nav>
  <img class="nav-logo" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Essence Maker Decor Logo">
  <a href="#contact">Book a Consult</a>
</nav>

<section class="hero">
  <div class="hero-inner">
    <img class="hero-logo" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Essence Maker Decor">
    <h1>Spaces that<br><span>reflect you.</span></h1>
    <p>Lagos-based interior design studio specialising in bespoke interiors, exterior décor, and high-quality paint finishes — crafted to tell your story.</p>
    <div class="hero-cta">
      <a href="#contact" class="btn-primary">Get in Touch</a>
      <a href="#services" class="btn-ghost">Our Services</a>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<div class="divider"></div>

<section class="services" id="services">
  <p class="section-label">What We Do</p>
  <h2 class="section-title">Every room, transformed.</h2>
  <div class="services-grid">
    <div class="service-card">
      <div class="service-icon">🛋️</div>
      <h3>Interior Design</h3>
      <p>Full concept-to-completion interior design tailored to your lifestyle and taste.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="service-card">
      <div class="service-icon">🏠</div>
      <h3>Exterior Décor</h3>
      <p>Striking facades and outdoor spaces that make a lasting first impression.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="service-card">
      <div class="service-icon">🎨</div>
      <h3>Paint & Finishes</h3>
      <p>Manufacturer of high-quality paints and proficient painting services for any surface.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="service-card">
      <div class="service-icon">🌿</div>
      <h3>Floral & Vases</h3>
      <p>Curated floral arrangements and decorative vases that breathe life into any space.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<div class="divider"></div>

<section class="why">
  <p class="section-label">Why Essence Maker</p>
  <h2 class="section-title">Craftsmanship you can feel.</h2>
  <div class="why-grid">
    <div class="why-item">
      <div class="why-num">145+</div>
      <h4>Projects Completed</h4>
      <p>A growing portfolio of beautifully transformed spaces across Lagos.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="why-item">
      <div class="why-num">100%</div>
      <h4>Custom Work</h4>
      <p>No templates — every project is designed uniquely for you.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="why-item">
      <div class="why-num">∞</div>
      <h4>Attention to Detail</h4>
      <p>From paint selection to final styling, nothing is left to chance.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="contact" id="contact">
  <p class="section-label">Reach Us</p>
  <h2 class="section-title">Let's build your space.</h2>
  <p style="font-size:0.85rem;color:var(--text-mid);line-height:1.8;">Ready to transform your space? DM us on Instagram or reach out directly — we'd love to hear about your vision.</p>
  <div class="contact-cards">
    <a class="contact-card" href="https://wa.me/2349011256043" target="_blank">
      <div class="label">WhatsApp</div>
      <div class="value">+234 901 125 6043</div>
    </a>
    <a class="contact-card" href="mailto:essencemaker101@gmail.com">
      <div class="label">Email</div>
      <div class="value">essencemaker101@gmail.com</div>
    </a>
    <a class="contact-card" href="https://instagram.com/essence_maker" target="_blank">
      <div class="label">Instagram</div>
      <div class="value">@essence_maker</div>
    </a>
  </div>
</section>

<footer>
  <p>© 2026 <span>Essence Maker Decor™</span> · Lagos, Nigeria · Spaces that reflect you.</p>
</footer>

</body>
</html>
